author.name: Rhea Fischer
author.headline: Van-lifer who wired the whole thing herself

body: A free-things map of Prague that pins forty museums, viewpoints and walking tours that cost nothing. Every "cheap" guide I found left out the tourist taxes and the airport transfer, so my real budget was off by a hundred dollars. Every price has a date next to it, so anyone can tell when it has gone stale. Need a photographer who has actually been there to make it look as good as it is.
